name: Chandler's Tools
summary: Wax pots, wick cord, and dipping frames for making candles, lamp oil, and torches.
description: A chandler's kit smells of tallow and beeswax, and its moulds and dipping frames fold flat for the road. Miners, temples, and besieged garrisons all pay well for people who can keep a flame burning.

tool.utilize: Tell what fuel a flame is burning by its smoke and smell (DC 10), or rig a candle or torch to burn twice as long as normal (DC 15)
